structure.unit: Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Municipal Public Property; Public Utilities
Approval of Water Supply Systems by Counties

law.catch_line: Contents of notice to governing body; further information
law.text: The applicant shall state in the notice to the governing body required by § 15.2-2149 the number and nature of the connections to which service will be given under the certificate applied for. The governing body may require such further information as it deems desirable in order to pass upon the application.
